paite: "Huan nang mihing tapa, namsau hiam mahmah la inla, na lu leh na khamul metna ding in sammetmi tem zang in; huan bukna la inla, sam khen in.
heading: Ezekiel Samtanna

paite: Seh thum a khen seh khat sim a a-om sung nite abei hun chiang in khopi lai a mei ah na hal ding ahi; seh thum a khen seh khat nawn na la dia, akim ah namsau in na satnen ding ahi; huan, seh thum a khen seh khat nawn huih mutleng ding in na thehzak ding a, ke'n namsau in ka delhzui ding hi.
Huan tawmchik na la ding a, na puanaktual mong ah na tun ding hi.
Hiaite lak a tam lou na la ding a, mei ah na thehlut ding a, na hal ding ahi; huai a kipan in Israel inkote tengteng ah mei ahong pawt ding," achi hi.
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Hiai Jerusalem khua ahi, namte' laizang ah ka koih a, akim ah gamte a-om hi.
Namte sang a nakpi a gitlouhna hih zaw in ka thugel tung ah ahel a, akim a gamte sang a thupizaw in ka dan bawl tung ah ahel uhi. Ka thugelte apaikhia ua, ka dan bawlte bang in a-om kei uhi."

Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Na kim a namte sang a buai hatzaw in na om a, ka dan thusehte bawl bang in na om kei a, ka thukhennate leng na zui kei ua, namte a dia ka thukhendan a na hih louh ziak un, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi:
Ngai un, kei, kei nangawn in leng ka hon nang ahi, namte mitmuh ngei in na lak uah vaihawmna ka tangtungsak ding hi.
Na kihhuaina tengteng uh ziak in thil ka hih ngei nai louh, hih leng ka hih ngei nawn louh ding na tung uah ka hih ding hi.
Huchi in pate'n na sung ah atate uh ane ding ua, tate'n leng apate uh ane ding uh; nang a mikhosuaksun tengteng ka dalhsak vek ding."

Huchi in hiai Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi: "Na nitna leh na kihhuainate a ka mun siangthou na hihnit ziak in, kei ka hin bang in, ka hon kiamsak ding a, ka mit in ahon maih het kei ding a, ka hon hehpih sam kei ding hi.
Seh thum a khen seh khat hipi in hiam, kial in hiam na lak uah asi ding uh; seh thum a khen seh khat nawn ka hihdalh ding a, namsau in ka delhzui ding hi."

Hichibang in ka hehna ka tangtungsak ding a, atung uah ka hehna ka lungdamsak ding a, ka om anuamta ding hi; kei TOUPA'N atung ua ka hehna ka lungdamsak hun chiang in phatuamngaitak in ka genta chih atheikhe ding uh.
Huai lou in, na kim a namte lak ah leh vialvak tengtengte mitmuh in kho segawp leh simmohhuai in ka hon bawl ding hi.
Huchi in thangpai leh heh mahmah a, nakpi a taihilh a, na tung a thugelte ka tunsak hun in na kim a namte mitmuh in nuihsan leh kouna leh hilhna leh mulkimhuai na hi ding; kei TOUPA'N ka chita hi.
Atung uah kialna thaltang hoih loutak manna ding, noumau manna ding ka hon kesak ding; na tung uah kialna ka uangsak ding a, na an uh, hinna bul ka hihse ding hi.

Huchi in na tung uah kialna leh gamsa hangte ka hon sawl ding a, ta leh nau tan in ahon laksak ding uh; hipi leh sisan suahna na lak uah aleng ding a; na tung uah namsau ka hon sawl ding, kei TOUPA'N ka chita hi, chi in.
